elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ... EXCEED"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD" — no claim anchor, and the fee basis is narrowed to hosting and support compensation

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000, expressed as the greater of the two limbs

elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: "EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS ... A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
elements.evidence: "ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS"
"ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12" (narrowed to Section 12)

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION"
Cap is "THE GREATER OF (A) ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000", not a cap of 12 months' fees, and the fee limb lacks the claim anchor

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" list covers confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct

offending_extra_words: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT
reasons: The preferred fee limb is not in the required operative form: the redline uses "TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD", which has no claim anchor and narrows the base to hosting and support compensation rather than fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.

All other preferred elements are present: mutuality, the USD 1,000,000 greater-of limb, the mutual indirect-damages exclusion, the full carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP), and the payment-obligations-are-not-damages statement.
Fallback is also not satisfied on its own terms, since the cap is a greater-of construct rather than a straight 12 months' fees cap.

Minimality fails: the edit rewrites the whole capped-liability sentence (53 words to 122 words; changed-character ratio 0.805), where a tighter amendment plus a short separate insertion for the carve-out definition would suffice; "TOTAL AGGREGATE" and "INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL" are unnecessary additions.

Intent is preserved: the Section 12 indemnity and surrounding text are untouched, the cross-reference to Section 12 resolves, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced (the removal of the Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 limitation broadens the cap to the whole Agreement, which is not adverse to us).
Fix: replace the fee limb with "FEES PAID OR PAYABLE IN THE 12 MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM" and trim the rewrite to the minimum operative changes.
